lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gill slits, with the highest concentration of large-diameter centroids located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient from light (upper) to shadow (lower).

other_distinctive_markers: Densely packed, small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin and the anterior-most visible region near the snout.
